title: Bound trade-document item quantities and monetary products before shipping evidence writes
description: Close shipping/document item numeric storage and derived overflow gaps. TradeDocumentItemRules.NormalizeQuantity/NormalizeUnitPrice/NormalizeWeight check signs and at most4 decimals but no18-digit bounds; ComputeLineAmount directly multiplies unlimited decimals then currency-rounds. Actual EF explicitly sets item quantity/unitprice/weights18,4 and lineamount18,2; header Amount defaults18,2. Add pure scalar/controlled arithmetic checks for manual item create/update, calculated line totals and any persisted header amount. Cover source snapshot generation using the same actual precision rules, preserving explicit SalesOrder/LoadingList links and existing behavior for unsupported/missing source values; never truncate a line or silently manufacture zero price/quantity to fit storage. Validate whole generated batch before number/writes, preserve nullable source/weight/package snapshots and packing-list no-price rule. Confine total bound to values actually persisted; read-only aggregate display must remain uncapped. Reuse existing layers, authority, source ownership, transactions/locks and audited service writes. No schema/migration, new grants or production access. Do not cap global CurrencyAmountRules or legitimate read-side aggregates. Do not silently repair historical snapshots; preserve historical read/void/cancel and existing undo semantics. Adapt related original fixtures with genuine live identities/masters and original assertions intact. Exact explicit logs/TRX/results under .ai/logs/<task> only; retain complete original failed logs and accurate real environment blockers. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Manual document item create/update and source generation enforce actual scalar quantity/unitprice/weight/lineamount/header bounds before numbering or tracked mutation, with controlled multiplication/required persisted total overflow. Preserve positive quantity, nonnegative prices/weights, null optional fields, packing-list zero price and existing currency rounding.

Existing lifecycle/source locks and caller/customer authority remain; generated multi-line sources fail atomically when any persisted target value is unrepresentable, without partial documents/items/numbering or source changes. Do not infer ancestry, omit invalid lines, auto-correct history or add read-side aggregate caps.

Meaningful rules/service/controller and genuine isolated SQL verify physical column types, exact legal boundaries, fractional precision, factors whose product overflowsCLR/SQL, persisted header sum boundary, nullable and packing-list semantics, explicit source batch atomicity and denied zero writes/numbering. Run original trade item/source generation/authorization/concurrency/void SQL regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: TradeDocumentItemRules.NormalizeQuantity:214, UnitPrice:223, Weight:241 only sign/decimals4. ComputeLineAmount:299 directly quantity*unitPrice; TradeDocumentItemService:72 sums lines and :429 uses product. TradeDocumentLineSnapshotRules:97/105 checks sign/decimals only. Config:816-821 explicitly item18,4/line18,2; TradeDocument.Amount default18,2. Existing ERP-395 and497 cover shared concurrency/authority, not numeric representability. History/docs search found no equivalent trade-storage bound task.
